content: प्रास्ताविक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) .²1 Serving as an introduction, introductory, prefatory; as in प्रास्ताविकविलास (the first or introductory part of Bhāminīvilāsa); प्रास्ताविकं वचनम् ‘prefatory remarks’. .²2 Seasonable, opportune, timely. .²3 Pertinent, relevant (to the matter in hand); अप्रास्ताविकी महत्येषा कथा <ls>Māl. 2</ls>.
